annotations.text:
Redesign of yt·transcribe — editorial / reading-first direction.

Warm off-white, Newsreader (serif display) + IBM Plex Sans/Mono, one terracotta accent. The summary and transcript are treated as the product.

Static mockups — to be built into the React app once the direction is signed off.

Two directions that were NOT chosen, kept as low-fi sketches so you can see the alternatives.

B: clean light, YouTube-native grid.
C: dark power-user tool.

The chosen editorial direction is on the Redesign page.
